text: whale population rebounded after the ban on industrial whaling?
oh something that whales make is needed by krill like their poop?
Did krill survive only where there were huge whale population, perhaps taking shelter under their bodies?
nutrients in whale poop are needed for krill to thrive?

It's called the "whale pump". Whales eat krills, then poop, it acts as a fertilizer for phytoplankton, that are eaten by krills. So more krills > more poop > more phytoplankton > more krills > more poop.
Btw - these phytoplankton produce almost 80% of earth's oxygen, and not forests
